description: SR-138 exception list (E03-T02): packages genuinely needing an install step under the repo's `ignoreScripts: true` (pnpm-workspace.yaml), run by tools/ci/run-allowed-postinstall.mjs. An entry without `run` gets `pnpm rebuild --no-ignore-scripts <name>` (its own postinstall/preinstall/install lifecycle scripts). An entry with `run` pins one `bin` of the package's own package.json, resolved from the `from` workspace, which the runner executes with node and no shell; it fails the run if the installed package no longer ships that bin, and refuses any other field. Reviewed by the Security engineer per this ticket's Definition of Done. Each entry documents why the script is safe (no network fetch beyond the package's own known, pinned binary download; no arbitrary code execution).

packages.name: electron
packages.reason: Downloads the pinned Electron binary for the desktop shell (apps/desktop, E02-T04). Electron 42 and later ship no postinstall script; the package's own install-electron bin (install.js) is the fetch. By default it downloads only from Electron's own GitHub releases and checks the file against the package's checksums.json, whose bytes pnpm-lock.yaml pins by integrity.
packages.reviewedBy: security-reviewer (E02-X01); the install-electron fetch re-reviewed under #1819

packages.name: esbuild
packages.reason: Downloads the pinned platform-specific esbuild binary, a transitive dev-dependency of vitest and vite and, since #3422, a direct devDependency of @candleviewer/ui (the build:tokens CSS check, exact-pinned to the version Vite resolves). Fetches only from esbuild's own release CDN, pinned by the exact version in pnpm-lock.yaml.
packages.reviewedBy: security-reviewer (E02-X01); the direct devDependency use re-reviewed under #3422
